study_design: Matched case-control analysis of prediagnostic serum selenium among CARET participants; the abstract also reports a case-only analysis of Gleason score and stage.
reason: The primary prostate cancer analysis concerns overall incident prostate cancer. The analysis of Gleason score and clinical or pathological stage was restricted to prostate cancer patients and does not establish an aggressive incident cancer endpoint versus cancer-free controls.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: No statistically significant trend in odds ratio was seen across quartiles of serum selenium for lung cancer (P = 0.49) or prostate cancer (P = 0.69).
estimate_classifications.reason: The prostate cancer odds-ratio trend is for overall prostate cancer. No effect estimate with both confidence bounds is reported.
